prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1088; do not mention it.)
text: I was driving my car and turning left at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, when another vehicle came through from the opposite direction and struck the side of my car. I had already started the turn and was moving slowly through the intersection when the impact happened. The collision pushed my vehicle sideways and jolted me forward and back against the seatbelt. The other driver did not appear to slow down before the crash. My car was damaged on the driver's side and the airbags did not deploy. Afterward I felt stiffness and pain in my neck and lower back, and I was sore the following morning. I stayed at the scene until the police arrived and gave my statement. I am reporting this incident so that my injuries and vehicle damage can be evaluated and documented.
